result.summary: Found 1 issue: a stuck loading indicator in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card that makes the content appear broken.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is stuck in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, preventing the food image from being fully visible and making the card appear broken or still loading.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading spinner once content has loaded, or ensure the loading state completes properly so the restaurant image displays correctly.
